reason: I'd sign up for the free trial because I do that with every AI tool, but 2 days is nothing and I'd be back on ChatGPT with my own saved prompts by Sunday. I already pay for a scheduler and I'm not adding another subscription that doesn't even publish.
objection: It doesn't publish, so I still copy-paste everything into my scheduler. That's one more tool and one more bill for a step I can already do with a free chatbot.
would_change_my_mind: If it pushed captions straight into my scheduler, or replaced the scheduler, and the free trial lasted long enough to run a full week of client captions.
